Procedural Volumetric Clouds · Jan Wedekind
Procedural Volumetric Clouds 03 May 2023 Volumetric clouds use 3D density functions to represent clouds in a realistic way. Ray marching is used to generate photorealistic rendering. With modern graphics cards it is possible to do this in realtime. Sebastian Lague's video on cloud rendering shows how to generate Worley noise which can be used to generate realistic looking clouds.
